text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: You seem really motivated this year too!
You seem really motivated this year too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. After all, I am preparing for the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now that I've conquered the spring Tenno Sho, my desire to win both spring and autumn in succession has grown all the stronger!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall hone my skills even more this summer camp so I may achieve a spectacular victory for the Mejiro family!
choice_data_list: I'll do everything I can to support you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll do whatever it takes. I don't care how strict your training is!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Create a regimen that will ensure my victory in the upcoming autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and I begin our final summer camp together!
